answer: The defence rests on customs declaration streak with port authority logs: declarations filed at one port across many years. Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. Forging 226 of these means building 226 separate declaration streaks from scratch, and years of history cannot be bought in bulk. A harbor marker runs through the scheme: every claim is checkable, every fake pays separately, and the whisper ledger turns 226 aliases into 226 bills while the forge path for the honest stays a single payment.
